previous.description: The gate for an ai-sdlc governed solution. A change moves through intent, spec, plan, build, verify and land; each artifact is challenged against a fixed set of rules before it advances, a person approves the three planning documents against a hash of each, and nothing merges unless the chain is complete, approved and hash-matched. This is the deterministic half: the `sdlc` command that every host hook, git hook and pipeline step calls. The stages need language and ship separately as the plugin.

current.description: The deterministic half of ai-sdlc, which holds an AI coding agent, and the people directing it, to what was written down. Every change is planned before any code exists, challenged by a reader that never saw it written, approved by a person against the exact text, and proved from recorded evidence, against rules and decisions that live in the repository and carry from one cycle to the next. This is the `sdlc` command every host hook and pipeline step calls: it decides everything a program can, including the pull-request check that refuses a change whose chain is incomplete, unapproved or hash-mismatched. The stages need language and ship separately as the plugin.
